verdicts.reason: A: the maroon panel has come loose from the copy and sits empty on the left as a meaningless square. The white headline and 'Join WADE team' sit on light grey with weak contrast, crammed together, and the X/line/circle accents are scattered at random. B: the headline is large and reads left to right, but it sits over the busy photo of a person. The decorative X, O and lines are blown up into the dominant central focal point, and 'Join WADE team' is stacked one word per line in a cramped maroon box at the far edge. B is slightly less broken because its headline is more readable.
